actions.custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
actions.custom_api_call.props.failsafe.d: On a failed request, output the error instead of failing the step.
actions.custom_api_call.props.followRedi: Follow 3xx redirects instead of returning them as the response.
actions.custom_api_call.props.headers.de: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.
actions.custom_api_call.props.response_i: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
actions.custom_api_call.props.timeout.de: Seconds to wait for a response. Empty: up to the flow limit (10 min).
actions.retrivePlan.description: Retrieve a customer plan from MoonClerk using the customer ID
actions.retrivePlan.props.customerId.des: The ID of the customer to retrieve the plan for
auth.description: Your Moonclerk API Key. You can find it in your Moonclerk account settings. (https://app.moonclerk.com/settings/api-key)
description: MoonClerk is an easy-to-use payment form builder for Stripe.
triggers.newPayment.description: Triggers when a payment is created in any state (failed, succeeded, etc).
triggers.newPayment.props.markdown.descr:
## MoonClerk Webhook Setup
                To use this trigger, you need to manually set up a webhook in your MoonClerk account:
    
                1. Login to your MoonClerk account.
                2. Navigate to **Account** -> **Settings** -> **Webhooks**.
                3. **Create webhook Endpoint**. keep state as active.
                4. Specify the following URL in the **Webhook URL** field:
                ```text
                {{webhookUrl}}
                ```
                5. Select the **Payment Created** event.
                5. Click Save Agent.
